traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Vochysiaceae: leaves opposite or whorled, rarely alternate; leaves simple; leaves evergreen; stipules present or absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior or inferior; floral cup present or absent; stems usually woody, rarely herbaceous; flowers in panicles; flowers zygomorphic; perianth usually sepals and petals, sometimes tepals; fruit capsule or samara; stamens 1 (-4); carpels 1 to 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.zygomorphy.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Vochysiaceae: its irregular flowers are of no named kind (pea flower, two lips, orchid lip), read from the coded corolla symmetry (spec-rework/b1/delta): zygomorphy other.
